name: field_repair_net
_comment: T455: both peers fly Heron. The server takes 150 off each (kill_mech amount, ticks 120/130), then each presses FIELD REPAIR (server 200, client 230): 5 s of repair, the server's call, reaching clients through _sync_health ~5x a second (snapshots carry no health). health_desync: the client's view of both mechs must track the server's while they climb back; crash_scan / rpc_integrity: the ring's RPC path (_rpc_ability_activated / _deactivated) on every peer. No turning: walking ~2 m/s with anchor_net's hard turns sits on the wifi p95 0.6 m line for any mech that fast (Pegasus with no ability failed 1 in 3 the same way, 2026-11-18); this scenario is about health, so the peers walk straight.
